articles.title: India Semiconductor Mission 2.0: Strategic Focus on Fabless Ecosystem and Compound Semiconductors
articles.summary: The Union Government has announced the expansion of the India Semiconductor Mission (ISM 2.0) to incentivize native fabless chip design, raw material supply chains, and specialized compound semiconductor foundries.
prelims: ISM 2.0 is executed under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
It includes expanded support under the Design Linked Incentive (DLI) scheme to promote IP ownership among domestic startups.
Compound semiconductors (like GaN and SiC) are essential for high-power electronics, EV powertrains, and 6G telecom networks.
articles.mains: Use in GS3 Economy and Science & Technology answers to demonstrate India's push for technological sovereignty, industrial upgrade, and global supply chain integration.

articles.title: India-Africa Maritime Security Framework: Strengthening SAGAR in the Western Indian Ocean
articles.summary: India expands its defense diplomacy in the Western Indian Ocean through joint hydrographic surveys, anti-piracy patrols, and capacity building under the SAGAR vision.
prelims: SAGAR stands for 'Security and Growth for All in the Region', introduced in 2015.
Key focus areas include Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA), Disaster Relief (HADR), and combating illegal, unreported, and unregulated (IUU) fishing.
Complements initiatives under the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) and Djibouti Code of Conduct.
articles.mains: Incorporate into GS2 International Relations answers regarding India's Global South leadership, Indo-Pacific strategy, and Indian Ocean regional security architecture.

articles.title: National Green Hydrogen Mission: Operationalization of SIGHT Electrolyser Hubs
articles.summary: First commercial-scale electrolyser manufacturing facilities under the Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition (SIGHT) scheme have begun operational trials.
prelims: The SIGHT scheme is a sub-component of the National Green Hydrogen Mission, implemented by the Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI).
Target: Reaching 5 MMT per annum of green hydrogen production capacity by 2030.
Electrolyser technology splits water into hydrogen and oxygen using renewable electricity.
articles.mains: Cite in GS3 Environment & Energy answers to address industrial decarbonization, energy security, and Net-Zero 2070 climate goals.

articles.title: Integration of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) with Panchayati Raj Institutions
articles.summary: Ministry of Panchayati Raj rolls out integrated e-GramSwaraj 2.0 featuring real-time AI translation via Bhashini for grassroots governance transparency.
prelims: e-GramSwaraj portal was launched to strengthen work-based accounting and planning in Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs).
Bhashini is Digital India's AI-led language translation initiative designed to overcome linguistic barriers.
Article 243G empowers Panchayats to prepare plans for economic development and social justice.
articles.mains: Utilize in GS2 Governance answers on democratic decentralization, last-mile delivery of public services, and rural digital inclusion.

articles.title: Deep Ocean Mission: MATSYA 6000 Prepares for Deep-Sea Resource Exploration
articles.summary: India's human submersible MATSYA 6000 successfully completes advanced sea trials under the Deep Ocean Mission led by the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
prelims: MATSYA 6000 is designed to carry three humans to a depth of 6,000 meters.
India has been allocated exploration rights for Polymetallic Nodules (PMNs) in the Central Indian Ocean Basin by the International Seabed Authority (ISA).
PMNs contain strategically crucial metals like nickel, cobalt, copper, and manganese.
articles.mains: Apply to GS3 Science & Tech and Resources questions addressing the Blue Economy, sustainable marine extraction, and deep-sea exploration capabilities.
